abstract: Twelve cases of malignant tumors in undescended testes were studied. Early diagnosis of these tumors was usually difficult as the testes were intrabdominal and the symptoms vague. Sixty percent of the seminoma cases were of the anaplastic aggressive variant. Early treatment of undescended testes included either orchiopexy or orchidectomy in early childhood. Exploratory laparotomy and frozen section examination of the abdominal nodes, followed by silver clip application, aided in better staging and the planning of further treatment.
abstract_ja: 停留精巣に生じた悪性腫瘍12例を検討した。精巣が腹腔内にあり症状も曖昧なため、これらの腫瘍の早期診断は通常困難であった。セミノーマ症例の60%は未分化で侵襲性の高い亜型であった。停留精巣の早期治療として、幼児期の精巣固定術または精巣摘除術を行った。腹腔内リンパ節の開腹探索と凍結切片による検査、その後のシルバークリップ留置により、病期分類の精度向上と以後の治療計画に役立った。
